text:
Type: galvanized steel plant pot
Use: holding a potted plant or herbs on a windowsill, shelf or table; kitchen, living room, balcony
Style: industrial, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: galvanized steel with a shiny zinc finish
Colors: silver grey metal
Shape: round bucket-like pot tapering toward the base, rolled rim, raised horizontal ribs around the body, compact and simple
Feel: fresh, practical, crisp, casual
Goes with: green herbs and leafy plants, white walls, reclaimed wood, black metal; industrial, farmhouse or rustic kitchens and living rooms

product.name: SOCKER
product.description: The plant pot is galvanised to protect against corrosion.
